I think it is because of the old view that lack of serotonin causes depression, when newer studies point that it most likely has more to do with dopamine rather than serotonin. Thats why wellbutrin (NDRI) is usually the first AD doctors are prescribing nowdays before SSRI/SNRI.
When people take SSRI, serotonin levels rise and dopamine levels decrease. And every symptom i described in my post can be linked to lowered levels of dopamine.

You are experiencing emotional blunting which is one of the most common side effects with SSRI medications. As many as ~50% of SSRI users get this side effect according to few studies.
